case_basis.authority: Leah can authorize scoped corrections and retain the packing hold. Model fit does not grant permission.

priced_scope: Up to four diagnostic credits for modeled checks on the longer permitted TARGETED branch.
unpriced_work: Preparation, recording, interpretation and final choice consume scheduled time with no separate resource price here. Replacement printing and revised-card release rehearsal lie outside diagnostic cost.

Physical diagnostic findings and successful 3:30 p.m. revised-card rehearsal

evidence_limit: Current screenshots show model calculations and a simulated path. The demo has no retained physical run. LOG-01 and the physical resolution are fictional examples; model coverage is not established by one preview or one illustrated run.
economic_limit: No dollar conversion, complete monetary acquisition cost or calculated economic information value is supplied. Campaign allocation does not establish remaining spending authority. USD 960 is potential exposure, not a measured saving.
schedule_limit: The global Gantt establishes dependencies only; production and packing durations and capacity remain to be confirmed. The minute-scale model assesses the earlier correction-instruction commitment.
